QUOTE: By default it expands to `private_##member`, so `ctx.nr` no longer compiles and callers must go through the API. Renaming the field makes it a visible break in the source, not a silent one.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says the macro renames the member (private_ prefix) so access fails at compile time, which is a name-breaking mechanism and not struct-layout hiding. It never says outright that the fields stay visible and sized, but the renaming mechanism and the compile-time failure are both stated.
